title: Better Utilz
description: fair and square server QoL utils! Enjoy :D
body:
QoL aditions:
- Repairing Anvils
  Shift-Click with an Iron ingot in your hand to repair the given anvil by 1 stage with a 50% sucess rate
- Filling up Xp Bottles
  Shift-Click while holding a empty Glass Bottle to fill it up with your current xp at the loss of the Bottle (also obviously some experience points)

New Recipes:
- Cobblestone
  Easely turn your Stone into Cobblestone in the Stonecutter.
- Cobbled Deepslate
  Same as with Stone but with Deepslate.


> **Note that this plugin is still in its **early Alpha** stage. Many featues might change, get added or revoked**
